name: cloud_native_p1
description: Docker-on-VM experiment P1: stateless unit conversion API
resource_constraints_text: Deploy to a Linux VM in the AWS Seoul region with a monthly budget of at most 100 USD. A single availability zone is acceptable.

classified.text: Users convert values between length, weight, and temperature units through a REST API.
External clients must access the API over HTTPS.
The service does not store server-side application data.
The application uses Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker and provides a GET /health endpoint.
